description: Find messages by a specific author, optionally filtered by date range. Uses the f: (from) search prefix.

after.description: Only return messages after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD)

author.description: Author name or email to search for

before.description: Only return messages before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD)

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

name: get_author_messages
